items.Sentence: Two grit channels, an Auger Monster auger and a Muffin Monster grinder
Two grit channels, an Auger Monster auger and a Muffin Monster grinder
One 300,000 gallon pre-aeration basin with anoxic zone equipped with three 20 HP floating aerators and a return activated sludge line. Detention time is 11 hours.

Two extended aeration basins with 150,000 gallon capacity each basin equipped with three 15 HP aerators. Detention time is 11 hours. Mixed Liquor Suspended Solids range is between 2,500 to 3,000 mg/L.
Two secondary clarifiers are on the backend for solids reduction. Each clarifier has a total volume of 112,811 gallons and each have a treatment capacity for 650,000 gpd.
Sludge is dewatered with a mechanical belt press.

Dewatered sludge is temporarily stored in roll-off bins and then hauled away by a local composting company. The ultimate destination of biosolids produced is Engle and Grey composting facility in Santa Maria, California.
Wastewater Disposal 8 percolation ponds with a 4 pond rotational cycle
